race.comment: TOTTORI (2) has been about the mark of late. Scored two back over 1800m at Murray Bridge then finished just 1.2 lengths away over the same trip at Morphettville in Saturday company. Faces a drop in grade and looms as a serious threat. CHARTIN (4) led for the judge but didn't quite get the 2200m at Balaklava recently. Has been in the top four at nine of 15 runs over today's distance. Should be prominent for a long way. ALLEGEDLY (14) backs up four days after a decent effort over 1500m at Gawler. Saves his best for Strathalbyn so do not dismiss. THEODOR (1) can turn things around in an easier race today.
